placement.note: Same placement server/chains/apex_core.py uses before slicing.

method: Not foot-shaped: 12-triangle rectangular prism 50.0 x 90.0 x 12.0 mm before placement. PCA of the plantar rectangle is the longer side (90.0 mm), which placement maps across the belt, not toe-to-heel. Axis used: placed model +Y (print direction, toe at min Y), length = oriented Y extent. The PCA-vs-+Y angle is reported so the disagreement is visible.
